tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Reports the CookiePal account this client is signed in as: the user, the organisation, the domain tools act on by default, and each domain’s plan and whether its page-view limit has been reached. Use it to confirm a connection, or to find out which domain other tools will use when none is given.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: Lists the domains in the connected CookiePal account that this user can see, with each domain’s plan, this month’s page views, whether its page-view limit has been reached, and whether its banner has been found installed. Plans are per domain.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Adds a website domain to the connected CookiePal account on the free plan, with the same checks as the CookiePal dashboard, and queues its banner build. Run this again any time to re-check. The local run this needs is made only by the CookiePal plugin in C

tools.name: customise_banner
tools.description: Changes how one of your CookiePal domains’ banner looks and reads: its colours, logo type and colour, positions, and the title, description and button texts per language. Give only what you want to change; everything else keeps its saved value. It does not upload a custom logo or change category tex

tools.name: regenerate_banner
tools.description: Queues a rebuild of the cookie banner script for one of your CookiePal domains, so it picks up the settings saved for it. It changes no setting and works on one domain only. If the domain has reached its page-view limit nothing is rebuilt, and the result says so.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_check, get_install_snippet · Private data: submit_check, verify_installation, upload_scan_report, classify_cookies, check_gcm_status · Public sink: plan_check, submit_check, verify_installation, upload_scan_report, classify_cookies, customise_banner · Destructive: plan_check, submit_check, forget_install, add_domain, verify_installation, start_scan, upload_scan_report, check_gcm_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_check, get_install_snippet · Private data: submit_check, verify_installation, upload_scan_report, classify_cookies, check_gcm_status · Public sink: plan_check, submit_check, verify_installation, upload_scan_report, classify_cookies, customise_banner · Destructive: plan_check, submit_check, forget_install, add_domain, verify_installation, start_scan, upload_scan_report, check_gcm_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
